Attached: 1 image

I did it!

It took some work (as do most things I try to do in Linux) but I got Nvidia drivers installed so that my install of a self-hosted photo organizing app Noodle Gallery (a fork of Immich) can utilize hardware acceleration on my GPU for its facial recognition!

Without this enabled the CPU was just constantly redlining.

#SelfHosted #SelfHosting #NoodleGallery #Immich
